newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee up vs forward dlr, spot rupee volatile.
newsitem.headline: India rupee up vs forward dlr, spot rupee volatile.

text.p: The Indian rupee gained mildly against the forward dollar on Tuesday after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) renewed roll-over of swaps, dealers said.
"RBI is receiving premia," said the chief dealer at a state-run bank. He said some foreign banks were paying premia.
May dollar premia slipped to 1.25/1.28 rupees in late morning deals from 1.28/1.31 opening, dealers said.
The spot dollar was quoted at 35.905/915 in latest deals compared to the day's peak of 35.92/95 and the opening level of 35.89/92, dealers said.
"There's selling interest among exporters at these levels," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
